claims.behavior: Exact checkbox defaults true. Apply persists the resize policy read live by an already-open media viewer. False retains its current detail zoom/pan and compensates a top-left window resize to preserve absolute screen position; true reinitializes the native default zoom and centered position. Cancel does not change the live policy. Legacy preference migrates.
limits: The native default zoom implementation has its existing limitations; reference per-filetype zoom-lock controls are separate unclaimed leaves.

claims.behavior: Exact checkbox defaults false and stages until Apply. Existing viewer and later files consult actual FileFlags::TRANSPARENCY metadata. Enabled transparent media receives alternating 16-logical-pixel RGB237/222 tiles aligned to the media box; disabled or opaque media uses its ordinary canvas background. Only visible tiles are created when zoomed. Persist/reopen, Cancel and legacy import are covered.
limits: The unchecked native canvas retains its existing dark colour, while reference normal backgrounds follow its configurable palette. Preview and duplicate-filter transparency policies remain separate leaves.

claims.behavior: Exact subordinate checkbox defaults false, stages until Apply and migrates legacy preferences. When checkerboard is enabled for transparent media, this preference selects reference RGB34/255/0 greenscreen. When checkerboard is disabled or media opaque it leaves the ordinary background. All four checkbox combinations are recorded and rendered, including open-viewer refresh, Cancel and reopen.
limits: The unchecked native canvas retains its existing dark colour rather than the reference configurable palette. Preview and backend-specific policies are unclaimed.

claims.behavior: Exact Seek bar height numeric control defaults20 and clamps1..255 pixels. Apply changes an open native animation viewer and persists/migrates the preference. The actual seek-bar and companion volume-control geometry use the configured full height when near the pointer or a popup/drag is active. Cancel keeps the applied height.
limits: The reference focus requirement is a separate unimplemented control; no focus-policy completion is claimed.

claims.behavior: Exact noneable Seek bar height when mouse away control defaultsSome5 and clamps1..255 pixels with reference phrase no, hide it completely. Apply changes collapsed native seek/volume geometry live; None renders no bar while away and restores the full configured height near it. Numeric/None cases, actual Qt visibility, persistence, Cancel and legacy migration are covered.
limits: Qt computes a5px ideal rectangle even when None hides its widget; native uses zero visible height. The recorder includes both reference geometry and actual visibility. Focus requirement is a separate unclaimed control.

claims.behavior: Exact Seek bar nub width numeric control defaults10 and clamps1..63 pixels. Apply updates the current viewer. Nub drawing uses floor((bar width minus nub width)*progress), with the reference endpoint/midpoint positions. Both animation frame seeking and player time seeking compensate clicks/drags by half the configured nub width and divide by the available width. Fresh reference mouse→frame targets and physical native nub pixels are asserted. Persist, Cancel and migration covered.
limits: Widths smaller than the nub are bounded safely by native rendering/seek arithmetic; no backend-specific playback option completion is claimed.
